core_image.text: 事実とぴったり合う(本当の)・誠実な
core_image.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 240 160"><rect width="240" height="160" fill="white"/><g fill="none" stroke="black" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><rect x="60" y="40" width="120" height="80"/><polyline points="90,80 110,100 150,60"/></g><text x="120" y="140" font-size="11" text-anchor="middle" fill="black" stroke="none">ほんとう</text></svg>

etymology: 古い英語 trēowe(忠実な・信頼できる) → 誠実な → 事実に合った・本当の → truth=真実

en_definitions.text: based on facts; real or genuine; loyal.

cautions: true=事実と合う(⇔false)/real=実在する・本物の
be true to A=Aに忠実だ
It is true that ... but ...=たしかに〜だが…(譲歩)

examples.label: 本当
examples.en: Is it true that you are moving?

examples.label: 忠実
examples.en: He was true to his word.

examples.label: 譲歩
examples.en: It is true that he is young, but he is very capable.
examples.ja: たしかに彼は若いが、とても有能だ。

check_points: come true の意味を言えるか
It is true that ..., but の構文がわかるか

exam.note: come true、譲歩の It is true ... but が出る。
